---
title: "Community Updates Privacy Notice"
toc: false
---

ISA RC42 Social Psychology uses your email address only to send notifications when new Community Contributions are published.

Your email address and subscription status are stored in a private Google Sheet accessible only to authorized ISA RC42 administrators. We also keep a minimal record of subscription confirmation and, when applicable, unsubscription so that we do not continue sending messages after you opt out.

You can unsubscribe at any time using the **Unsubscribe** link included in every Community Updates email. To request deletion or ask a question about this subscription data, contact ISA RC42 through the contact information published on this website.

Subscription data is not published in the ISA RC42 GitHub repository or displayed publicly on the website.
